arras_sdist.scope: retained container identity only; not rebuilt or executed by reviewer

tests.execution_observer: coordinator; independent reviewer read retained XML/log and inspected test assertions
tests.scope: Includes structural unit controls and genuine installed semantic/generated-client cases; not 39 separate end-to-end application scenarios.

a2_regression.custom_registry_callbacks: reference-oracle test only; production admission uses fresh empty Registry

controls: work-copy failure before atomic publish preserves state/rows/sequence/replay/tokens
expiry serializes behind action publication; later expired repeat refuses before readmission/replay
structural_custody_followup.scope: controlled bridge doubles prove provider custody, not official semantic evaluation
structural_custody_followup.owner_reported_full_file_result_scope: Final frozen file, including explicit shared-lock ownership assertion; coordinator reran all 19 and reviewer checked retained XML.
structural_custody_followup.final_strengthening: Main thread proves shared serialization lock cannot be acquired while action validation is blocked, before expiry worker starts; noncompletion timing is not the sole witness.

historical_failed_attempt.resolution: narrow fixed-code translation; failed attempt retained

limits: One module, required STRING key and constrained required STRING value; one parameter-bound SET with empty conditions/outputs/failures and no handlers or relationships.
Public registration/import/Apply/Validate/query read-at-least are qualified on this exact memory candidate; no generated get/read transport is claimed.
Replay and issued visibility tokens have one-process memory lifetime; no durable restart, replica, federation or Ashlar proof.
No Truss, PostgreSQL, managed identity/ACL, Lakebase or general action/constraint support claim.
SDK is a qualified local candidate, not a published dependency; released optional-extra pin and lock remain unchanged.
Selected package origins and payload parity were checked; no global dependency/alias/.pth audit or no-SDK fresh-environment gate is inferred.
Full base source suite remains separately open after a timing failure and interrupted diagnostic rerun; remote CI must supply that gate.
Private paths, raw hostnames, raw logs and raw JUnit are omitted.
